subject: banshee-haven
q: CLOSED — yes. The house spawns in Arc 13, after Bell and Elspeth arrive.
detail: Confirmed. The Arc 13 and Arc 14 casts are Banshee Haven's residents, and the house builds itself once Bell and Elspeth are adopted — the same thing the land did for Ghost Haven and Specter Haven. All twelve house-inferred flags are off.
